name: TLW Open project link
query:
SELECT
    name AS "Project ID:Link/Project Setup:150",
    project_name AS "Project Name:Data:200",
    status AS "Status:Data:100",
    expected_start_date AS "Expected Start Date:Date:150",
    expected_end_date AS "Expected End Date:Date:150",
    completion_date AS "Completion Date:Date:150",
    owner AS "Created By:Data:150",
    creation AS "Created On:Datetime:150"
FROM
    `tabProject Setup`
WHERE
    status = 'Open'
ORDER BY
    expected_start_date ASC;
